WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM matched
)
SELECT
  m.zoneref AS site_reference,
  m.insurstat AS insurance_status,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS share_of_matched_records
FROM matched AS m
CROSS JOIN totals
GROUP BY m.zoneref, m.insurstat
ORDER BY (m.insurstat IS NULL) ASC, share_of_matched_records DESC
LIMIT 10;
